title: Afluencia y conversión — comparativa de sucursales

list.name: sites
list.label: Sucursales
list.query: SELECT store_name AS __text, store_id AS __value FROM sites WHERE status = 'operational' ORDER BY store_name

panels.title: Visitantes
panels.description: Suma de personas que entraron al local en el período seleccionado, sumando todas las sucursales filtradas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(ins) AS "Visitantes" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de captación
panels.description: Promedio ponderado del cociente visitantes / tráfico cercano (de los que se acercaron al local, qué porcentaje entró).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(ins)::float / NULLIF(SUM(shoppers), 0) AS "Captación" FROM turn_in_rate_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de conversión
panels.description: Promedio ponderado del cociente compradores / visitantes. Requiere que la sucursal envíe transacciones POS.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(visits), 0) AS "Conversión" FROM conversion_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Facturación
panels.description: Suma de ventas menos devoluciones en el período. Expresado en pesos argentinos (la unidad menor de la moneda dividida por 100).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(amount_minor_sale - amount_minor_return) / 100.0 AS "Facturación" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ticket promedio
panels.description: Facturación neta dividida por la cantidad de compradores (excluye devoluciones del denominador).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, (SUM(amount_minor_sale) - SUM(amount_minor_return))::float / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) / 100.0 AS "Ticket promedio" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Unidades por ticket
panels.description: Unidades vendidas dividido por la cantidad de compradores (UPT). Mide cuántas prendas se lleva en promedio cada comprador.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(items_sale)::float / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) AS "Unidades por ticket" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Duración promedio de visita
panels.description: Estimada por la Ley de Little (W = L / λ). Solo el promedio del período; no incluye distribución. Se degrada en horas pico y al abrir o cerrar el local.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(visit_duration_minutes * arrivals) / NULLIF(SUM(arrivals), 0) AS "Duración (min)" FROM visit_duration_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tráfico externo, cercano y visitantes por día
panels.description: El embudo en barras agrupadas por día: tráfico externo (transeúntes) → tráfico cercano (se acercan al local) → visitantes (entran). Una sola escala — cada etapa es subconjunto de la anterior, por eso el externo es el más alto y el visitante el más bajo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day), 'DD/MM') AS "Día", SUM(w.passersby) AS "Tráfico externo", SUM(w.shoppers) AS "Tráfico cercano", SUM(c.ins) AS "Visitantes" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c FULL OUTER JOIN wifi_ble_by_bucket_day w ON c.store_id = w.store_id AND c.bucket_day = w.bucket_day WHERE COALESCE(c.store_id, w.store_id) IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day)

panels.title: Embudo de conversión
panels.description: Embudo: tráfico externo → tráfico cercano → visitantes → compradores. Cada barra es proporcional al tope (tráfico externo); el área sin llenar = la caída respecto de la etapa anterior. Color por etapa.

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT SUM(w.passersby) AS passersby, SUM(w.shoppers) AS shoppers, SUM(c.ins) AS visitantes, SUM(p.sales) AS compradores FROM counting_by_bucket_day c FULL OUTER JOIN wifi_ble_by_bucket_day w ON c.store_id = w.store_id AND c.bucket_day = w.bucket_day FULL OUTER JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON COALESCE(c.store_id, w.store_id) = p.store_id AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day) = p.bucket_day WHERE COALESCE(c.store_id, w.store_id, p.store_id) IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day, p.bucket_day) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date) SELECT passersby AS "Tráfico externo", shoppers AS "Tráfico cercano", visitantes AS "Visitantes", compradores AS "Compradores" FROM totals

panels.title: Composición demográfica de los visitantes
panels.description: Distribución de los visitantes por categoría etaria estimada (basada en altura medida por estéreo).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(ins_adult) AS "Adultos", SUM(ins_child) AS "Niños", SUM(ins_unknown) AS "Sin clasificar" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date

panels.title: Top 5 sucursales por visitantes
panels.description: Las cinco sucursales que más personas recibieron en el período seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.store_name AS "Sucursal", SUM(c.ins) AS "Visitantes" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: 5 sucursales con menor conversión
panels.description: Sucursales con menor cociente compradores / visitantes en el período. Excluye sucursales sin tráfico.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.store_name AS "Sucursal", SUM(p.sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(c.ins), 0) AS "Conversión" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON c.store_id = p.store_id AND c.bucket_day = p.bucket_day WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY s.store_name HAVING SUM(c.ins) > 0 ORDER BY 2 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

panels.title: Visitantes por día de la semana × hora
panels.description: Visitantes por día de la semana (filas) y hora del día (columnas), promediados sobre el rango seleccionado (con 7 días = el valor de cada día; con rangos más largos = el patrón típico). Celdas coloreadas por intensidad.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT (bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS dd, extract(isodow FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS dow, extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hr, SUM(ins) AS tot FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT CASE dow WHEN 1 THEN 'Lun' WHEN 2 THEN 'Mar' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mié' WHEN 4 THEN 'Jue' WHEN 5 THEN 'Vie' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sáb' WHEN 7 THEN 'Dom' END AS "Día", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=0)),0) AS "00:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=1)),0) AS "01:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=2)),0) AS "02:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=3)),0) AS "03:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=4)),0) AS "04:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=5)),0) AS "05:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=6)),0) AS "06:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=7)),0) AS "07:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=8)),0) AS "08:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=9)),0) AS "09:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=10)),0) AS "10:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=11)),0) AS "11:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=12)),0) AS "12:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=13)),0) AS "13:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=14)),0) AS "14:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=15)),0) AS "15:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=16)),0) AS "16:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=17)),0) AS "17:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=18)),0) AS "18:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=19)),0) AS "19:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=20)),0) AS "20:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=21)),0) AS "21:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=22)),0) AS "22:00", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=23)),0) AS "23:00" FROM d GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow

panels.title: Resumen por sucursal
panels.description: Tabla con los principales indicadores por sucursal. Click en el nombre para ver el detalle.

targets.rawSql: WITH actual AS (SELECT c.store_id, s.store_name, SUM(c.ins) AS visitantes, SUM(p.sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(c.ins), 0) AS conversion, SUM(t.ins)::float / NULLIF(SUM(t.shoppers), 0) AS captacion, (COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_sale), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_return), 0))::float / 100 AS facturacion FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON c.store_id = p.store_id AND c.bucket_day = p.bucket_day LEFT JOIN turn_in_rate_by_bucket_day t ON c.store_id = t.store_id AND c.bucket_day = t.bucket_day WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY c.store_id, s.store_name), previo AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(ins) AS visitantes_prev FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '7 days')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '7 days')::date GROUP BY store_id) SELECT a.store_id AS "ID", a.store_name AS "Sucursal", a.visitantes AS "Visitantes", (a.visitantes - COALESCE(pr.visitantes_prev, 0))::float / NULLIF(pr.visitantes_prev, 0) AS "Δ vs semana anterior", a.captacion AS "Captación", a.conversion AS "Conversión", a.facturacion AS "Facturación" FROM actual a LEFT JOIN previo pr USING (store_id) ORDER BY a.visitantes DESC

panels.title: Dispositivos únicos por día (WiFi/BLE)
panels.description: Cantidad de dispositivos distintos detectados por día tras stitching local del device (un dispositivo con N rotaciones de MAC cuenta como 1).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (bucket_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') AS time, SUM(visitors) AS "Dispositivos únicos" FROM wifi_ble_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de atracción
panels.description: De los transeúntes del período (tráfico externo), qué porcentaje se acercaron al local (tráfico cercano, RSSI ≥ -55 dBm) — proxy de atracción de la vidriera.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (bucket_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') AS time, SUM(shoppers)::float / NULLIF(SUM(passersby), 0) AS "Atracción" FROM wifi_ble_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Repetición intra-día (engagement)
panels.description: Distribución de dispositivos según cuántas ventanas de 15 min los observaron. 1 ventana = pasaron rápido; 3+ ventanas = rondaron o se quedaron cerca — proxy de engagement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE windows_bucket WHEN '1' THEN '1 ventana' WHEN '2' THEN '2 ventanas' WHEN '3-5' THEN '3-5 ventanas' ELSE '6+ ventanas' END AS "Ventanas", SUM(visitors) AS "Dispositivos" FROM wifi_engagement_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY windows_bucket ORDER BY MIN(CASE windows_bucket WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3-5' THEN 3 ELSE 6 END)
